rv.q: Daniel and his cast make the evening worthwhile.
The plot snowballs from there to a bittersweet conclusion at once heartbreaking and transcendently meaningful.
With a running time of 95 minutes, Hymn serves up serio-comedy with many themes to laud.
Nothing is blatantly wrong with Hymn , except that it is just exasperatingly unexciting.

Unfortunately, a worthy theme won’t compensate for a fractured narrative, and despite the efforts of two skilled and sensitive performers and an accomplished/seasoned director, the production stumbles.

cn.t: Two powerful performances anchor this exploration of half-brothers bonding later in life, but critics find the narrative fractured and the script unable to fully support its worthy themes of fellowship and family.
